reason: I might install it for the free tracking and quick add, but I don't pay for utility apps, and nothing in Pro is something I'd miss. AI food photos and a coach chat won't get me to the gym.
objection: Auto-tracking always misses or double-counts transactions and I end up cleaning it up. A brand-new app from a solo developer with no reviews makes me think that will be worse, not better, and I'm not handing my bank link to it lightly.
